policy.source_truth: checked-in conformance rows, native fixtures, runtime probes, and canonical support manifests
policy.positive_negative_rule: claim rows must carry at least one durable positive executable evidence path and at least one durable negative or strict-error evidence path

source_truth_requirements: Protocol-qualified generic argument support is claimed only through the checked-in semantic fixture and TYP-8013-15 conformance row
Constraint violations and unknown protocol-qualified generic arguments remain fail-closed O3S206 evidence
Generated type semantic reports are replay artifacts only and are not source truth for this claim
Variance specialization support is claimed only for the semantic fixtures that preserve declared covariance and nested generic canonical spelling
Invariant assignment, nested constraint failure, and substituted unknown-message paths remain fail-closed evidence
This row does not claim higher-kinded types, inferred associated types, or generic collection ABI
Protocol-qualified existential value flow is claimed only for checked-in semantic fixtures using id<Protocol> object qualifiers, optional chaining, and declared protocol members
Duplicate protocol composition, unknown protocol identifiers, and undeclared selector sends on protocol-qualified receivers remain fail-closed evidence

This row does not claim public witness tables, existential ABI records, dynamic existential dispatch, associated types, protocol composition beyond the typed semantic suffix, or cross-module existential import/export
Cross-module generic metadata support is claimed only for deterministic preservation of generic interface count, parameter variance, and protocol-qualified generic argument counts
Runtime-import drift that drops variance annotations must fail closed before any public generic import claim is widened
Replay manifests are checked-in evidence for deterministic lowering/ABI handoff, not a replacement for source fixture coverage
